title: Reliability initiative tracker: Error-budget orchestration and OKR alignment
creator: Sofia Ramirez
description:
Objective: Build an initiative-level tracker that automatically maps per-service SLIs and error-budget spend to product OKRs, surfaces at-risk rollouts, and provides recommended mitigation actions.

Scope: 1) Schema and data pipeline for daily error-budget calculation across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. 2) Initiative dashboard showing cumulative error-budget usage, projected burn rate, and OKR linkage. 3) Automated alerts and gating suggestions for canary/rollout features when error budgets cross thresholds. 4) Lightweight governance workflow (acknowledge, mitigation plan, rollback window).

Why: Current SLO reporting is siloed by team and lacks a single view that ties reliability regressions to business initiatives and planned rollouts. This causes surprise rollbacks and manual coordination during incidents. The tracker should reduce cross-team coordination time and make release gating data-driven.

Success criteria (by due_date):
- Daily error-budget ingestion for 95% of SLI sources across priority services.
- Initiative dashboard shows projected 7-day burn and flags at-risk initiatives with >= 80% precision.
- Two pilot product teams adopt the gating suggestions for at least one rollout and report improved decision time.

Out of scope for this ticket: long-term RBAC for private deployments (handled in a follow-on ticket), and SLI definition standardization (we will consume existing SLI catalog).
acceptance_criteria: Automated pipeline writes daily error-budget metrics for services listed in initiative meta (>=95% coverage)
Dashboard UI surfaces per-initiative cumulative burn, 7-day projection, and recommended action (throttle/canary-hold/rollback)
Alert rules created in ops-monitoring for three thresholds (50%, 80%, 100%) mapped to escalation playbooks
Pilot run completed with two product teams and pilot retro notes recorded
tasks: Define initiative metadata schema and mapping to service SLIs (PM + Eng)
Implement ETL job to aggregate daily SLI windows into error-budget ledger (Eng)
Design dashboard mockups and review with pilot teams (Design + PM)
Hook alerts into existing Ops pager and Slack channels (Eng + SRE)
Run pilot with product teams A and B and collect feedback
metrics: % of services with daily error-budget ingestion
precision/recall of at-risk initiative flagging versus manual review
mean time to decision for gated rollouts (pre vs post pilot)
number of rollouts using recommended mitigation actions
